verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right flow (logo → product → headline → readable CTA pill), but the headline 'Garden-fresh fizz' is shrunk to tiny caption size under a minuscule product, so the CTA and the widely spaced logo outrank the message. B has a large, dominant headline, but the 'Find a Store' CTA is squeezed into an illegible micro-button stacked under the logo against the left edge. The logo, CTA and tiny product are crammed into the left third, so the CTA is effectively lost.
